experiment: CANDLE V4 coverage-aware negatives controlled development

source_fixture.selection_rule: receiver ID, class pair IDs, donor tuple IDs, filler IDs ascending after eligibility
source_fixture.scope: Opportunity at current graph only; not functional-gap proof or predicted acceptance

preflight_cost.policy: all-to-all graph descriptor projections; no model or raw samples
preflight_cost.graph_weight_policy: positive uniform eligibility weights at pre-optimizer clock, not aggregation alpha

protocol.loss: 0.5 positive mean + 0.5 negative class-balanced expectation; importance weights from BASE counts only
protocol.negative_selection: Classes with zero BASE coverage across primary donor+receiver; choose smallest current eligible peer ID with >=32 BASE samples per missing class; request only that negative class
protocol.ablation: Same generic implementation with extra negative contributors disabled
protocol.schedule: Replay only the current recorded native graph per round; no native retraining or claim of new online integration
protocol.endpoints: Round7 only, no early stopping or winning-round selection; FIT opened after all training arms complete
protocol.primary: FIT-select donor recall95 order statistic then evaluate FIT-assess
protocol.FIT_partition: sha256(FP32 input bytes) first8 bytes as big-endian integer %2: 0=threshold select,1=assessment; owner-independent
protocol.pooled_dedup: assessment: unique (feature content hash,label), first owner ID retained; owner pools also reported
protocol.objective: Lower expert12->class13 false activation without donor/pooled target recall or candidate accuracy loss; report each criterion separately, no deployment PASS
protocol.evidence_independence: Development only. Hypothesis motivated by earlier aggregate CAL rejection; no rejected CAL rows read or used to fit/tune/confirm
protocol.communication: Independent serialized references/gradients per arm; common immutable native FIT reference and identity receipts charged separately; no real network benchmark

communication.mode: Serialized in-process simulation; native reference immutable/shared once, BASE/FIT raw samples never sent

experiment_receipt.conclusion_scope: One seed, development only; no confirmation, deployment acceptance or native integration claim

decision: Development evidence only; no CAL/ACTIVE/full authorization
interpretation: Ablation exactly reproduces original model weights and assessment predictions
Only expert with uncovered negative classes changes weights; peer2 supplies class13 negatives by a generic metadata rule
Primary +101 unique correct; fixed0.5 secondary +6 net with9 gained/3 lost owner events
Benefits combine newly covered negative class and redistribution of fixed class-balanced negative budget
FIT reused development lineage; partition is not independent confirmation
The three prior rejected CAL samples were not opened, trained on or used for threshold selection; no claim they are fixed
